content:
mira: Quick heads-up: we're GAing the Hosted API 'priority-stream' path next week. It's an opt-in streaming endpoint tuned for interactive apps and includes a new conservative tool-call throttle. This thread is for final cross-team signoff.

dan: What's the exact endpoint and header? I'll update SDKs.

mira: Endpoint: POST /v2/priority-stream/stream. Opt-in via header X-Redwood-Priority: 1. Default behavior same as regular streaming unless header set.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1900712400 for priority-stream-canary. Job=priority-deploy-409, health=monitoring.

ops: Canary targets: 3% traffic in us-east-1 for 30m, then 15% region-wide if healthy. Rollback if stream-first-byte P95 > 150ms or error rate > 1%.

tara: Support note: we'll get questions about faster response and headers for rate-limits. Draft canned reply ready, includes link to docs and how to request Dedicated capacity for SLA.

alex: Legal ok with messaging as long as we avoid promising latency SLAs. Confirmed.

dan: Technical note: priority stream reduces batching window to 8ms and pre-warms KV caches on connect. Tool-calls are capped at 12 calls/min per-tool per-key for hosted to prevent storms.

mira: Example request: 
```http
POST /v2/priority-stream/stream HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <key>
X-Redwood-Priority: 1
Content-Type: application/json

{ "model": "mosaicx-priority-1", "input": "Write a short summary", "max_tokens": 120 }
```

ops: Monitoring checklist: stream-connect success, first-byte P50/P95, fallback rate metric, tool-throttle events, KV-cache-hit. Pager if fallback rate > 0.7% for 5m or tool-throttle events spike >5/min.

mira: Marketing will send GA email Tue 9am PT. Docs PR will include migration tips + client retry guidance.

dan: SDKs: I'll add X-Redwood-Priority header helper and sample code tonight.

tara: Support will publish KB and add quick response templates.

mira: Thanks all. Ping if we hit any blockers during canary. GA planned Tue next week pending green light. :rocket:
